# OpenComputer Sandboxes

> Full Linux virtual machines in the cloud for running AI applications and untrusted code.

## Sandboxes

- [Introduction](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/introduction.md): Install an SDK and create your first cloud sandbox.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/quickstart.md): Create a sandbox, run commands, and clean it up.
- [How it works](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/how-it-works.md): Understand sandbox isolation, persistence, hibernation, checkpoints, and networking.
- [Overview](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/overview.md): Learn the sandbox lifecycle and core API.
- [Running commands](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/running-commands.md): Execute commands and manage processes.
- [Working with files](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/working-with-files.md): Read, write, upload, and download files.
- [Mounts](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/mounts.md): Attach persistent storage to sandboxes.
- [Signed URLs](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/signed-urls.md): Transfer files with signed URLs.
- [Interactive terminals](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/interactive-terminals.md): Open interactive PTY sessions.
- [Timeouts](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/timeout.md): Configure sandbox lifetime and idle behavior.
- [Checkpoints](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/checkpoints.md): Snapshot, restore, and fork sandbox state.
- [Templates](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/templates.md): Build reusable sandbox environments.
- [Secrets](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/secrets.md): Provide credentials without exposing secret values.
- [Patches](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/patches.md): Capture and apply filesystem changes.
- [Preview URLs](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/preview-urls.md): Expose sandbox services over HTTPS.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/webhooks.md): Receive sandbox lifecycle events.
- [Elasticity](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/elasticity.md): Resize CPU and memory at runtime.
- [Burst sandboxes](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/burst-sandboxes.md): Run short-lived burst workloads.
- [Usage](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/usage.md): Inspect sandbox resource usage and tags.
